42def test_int_to_bytes_rejects_zero_length(): 

43 with pytest.raises(ValueError): 

44 cryptography.utils.int_to_bytes(123, 0) 

45 with pytest.raises(ValueError): 

46 cryptography.utils.int_to_bytes(0, 0)

49def test_check_backend_support_skip(): 

50 supported = pretend.stub( 

51 kwargs={"only_if": lambda backend: False, "skip_message": "Nope"} 

52 ) 

53 node = pretend.stub(iter_markers=lambda x: [supported]) 

54 item = pretend.stub(node=node) 

55 with pytest.raises(pytest.skip.Exception) as exc_info: 

56 check_backend_support(True, item) 

57 assert exc_info.value.args[0] == "Nope (True)" 

58 

59 

60def test_check_backend_support_no_skip(): 

61 supported = pretend.stub( 

62 kwargs={"only_if": lambda backend: True, "skip_message": "Nope"} 

63 ) 

64 node = pretend.stub(iter_markers=lambda x: [supported]) 

65 item = pretend.stub(node=node) 

66 assert check_backend_support(None, item) is None

4454def test_raises_unsupported_algorithm():
